name: eBay listing: NVIDIA A100 40GB SXM4 module, pre-owned (item 158338471596)
notes: Live listing read 2026-10-03. Title 'NVIDIA 699-2G506-0200-310-V A100 40GB SXM4 HBM2 GPU', price US $2,499.00 or Best Offer, condition Used. Seller condition text carries the compliance clause: 'SXM4 Connection. US only. Requires Compliance Approval'. Seller Core 4 Solutions IT Hardware (20,700 feedback), Eden Prairie, Minnesota, free FedEx Ground, 30-day returns buyer-pays. Confirms that US-only-plus-compliance-approval is the standard, openly-stated gating on used SXM parts, and that the A100 40GB SXM module floor on eBay is roughly $2.5k.
